records.title: Tsiolkovsky Rocket Delta V Calculator
records.topic_review: Verified factual model: Δv = v_e ln(m₀/m_f). Scope reviewed: Required: m₀≥m_f>0 and 0<v_e<c. Both masses include the complete vehicle immediately before and after this burn. Classical motion with constant effective exhaust speed and aligned exhaust is assumed. Effective speed may include an equivalent pressure-thrust contribution. Excluded: gravity losses, drag, external forces, jettison and stage separation. Results Δv≥c are rejected; relativistic motion requires a relativistic rocket equation.

records.title: Eddington Luminosity Calculator
records.topic_review: Verified factual model: L_Edd = 4πGMc/κ. This is not an absolute luminosity ceiling for every object.
